forecast.event: additional 2% drawdown in subsequent hourly closes
forecast.regimes: PEGGED >=0.995; WATCH <0.995 or hourly return <-0.002; DEPEG <0.99; DISTRESSED <0.95

guard.rule: two consecutive closed hours below 0.995 USD with latest close falling
guard.destination: actual USDT-USD closes (USD cash for USDT source)

limitations: Historical snapshots retrieved now, not a vintage-data archive.
One training collapse is insufficient to calibrate rare incident risk.
Price-only counterfactual; vault availability, historical liquidity and order fills unverified.
No parameter changes selected on held-out outcomes.

caveats: No historical order-book depth, market fill or vault withdrawal is established.
Costs are sensitivity assumptions, not historical executable quotes.
Post-signal benefit compares subsequent minimum hourly-close source/destination values; these minima may occur at different times, not a tradable return.
Intrahour lows include isolated venue prints; suspicious bars are retained and flagged, not used for hourly-close benefit.
Missing candles are not forward filled; alarms with missing future labels are unknown.
